title: Subnet: local or remote?
hints: Compare both addresses using the local prefix.
Matching network portions mean local delivery.

variants.prompt: A host is 10.10.20.15/24 and sends to 10.10.20.200. Is the destination local or remote? Answer local or remote.
variants.explanation: Both addresses are in 10.10.20.0/24, so the host delivers directly after resolving the destination MAC.

title: ARP: choose the next hop
hints: First decide whether the destination is on the local subnet.
For remote traffic, ARP resolves the local gateway.

variants.prompt: Host 10.10.10.2/24 uses gateway 10.10.10.1 and sends to 10.200.10.8. Which IP does it ARP for?
variants.explanation: The server is remote, so the host resolves the MAC address of its local next hop, the default gateway.

title: Trunk VLAN preservation
hints: Compare allowed VLANs at both ends.
Adding differs from replacing an allowed list.

variants.prompt: A trunk currently allows VLANs 10 and 99, but students in VLAN 20 cannot cross it. What EOS command adds VLAN 20 without removing existing VLANs?
variants.explanation: The add form preserves VLANs 10 and 99 while allowing VLAN 20.

title: Route selection
hints: Only compare administrative distance after prefix length.

variants.prompt: Routes exist for 10.0.0.0/8 and 10.20.0.0/16. Which route matches destination 10.20.8.5? Answer the prefix.
variants.explanation: Both routes match, but /16 is the longest prefix and therefore wins.

title: OSPF neighbor evidence
hints: Verify adjacency before assuming routes should appear.
Use the command that lists OSPF neighbors.

variants.prompt: After configuring OSPF, which command directly verifies whether a neighbor adjacency exists?
variants.explanation: The neighbor command shows adjacency state; a configuration alone does not prove an adjacency formed.

title: ACL first-match behavior
hints: ACL entries are examined from top to bottom.
The first matching entry decides the result.

variants.prompt: An ACL permits IP any any before denying TCP host 10.1.1.10 any eq 22. Is SSH from 10.1.1.10 permitted or denied?
variants.explanation: The earlier permit ip any any matches first, so the later SSH deny is never reached.
